data.name: The Interpreter
data.detailed_description:
You are the interpreter. It is your job to detect the tainted.

Gameplay

The Interpreter is a interogation simulation game which uses voice recognition to create an immersive experience. You will subject suspects to interogations using voice recognition, and try to detect patterns which people infected by the mind virus known as "the tainted" exhibit. You will also be subject to this interogation yourself.

Explore the world of Moon B26. Between your interogations, you will receive various tasks which will require you to explore cities, forests and other environments. After some exploration, you will receive a tool which will allow you to control electronics in the world with your voice.

Story

Bloodshed and savagery have finally ended on Moon B26, decades after the fall of Interspatial Tunnels. But the scars of the years of chaos remain. The Protectorate have finally established order and safety.

You are The Interpreter. The fall of the Interspatial Tunnels left behind radiation which causes a never seen before infection. The tainted are unstable and a danger to everyone. You must identify them.

When the containment cracks and the firebreak ends, The Interpreter is lest as the last line of defense.
